explanation: Aunt Fosuwa represents the traditional order in the play. She believes in polygamy which is an ancient tradition of the Ghanaian people. She also tries to convince James to allow his daughter, Manaan to be Lawyer B's second wife and expresses her belief that there is nothing wrong with marrying more than one wife as long as one has the means to take care of them.

question: This question is based on J.C. De Graft's Sons and Daughters . Where does the play take place?
explanation: The play takes place in Ofosu's house because this is the main setting of the play and they are the main characters. All actions in the play involves them.
